source_title: FDOT Rule 14-26.008 F.A.C. — Schedule of Fees for Overweight/Overdimensional Permits
verify_reasons: The sourced FDOT text is the Rule 14-26.008 fee schedule only; it does not publish the escort/pilot-car matrix (width/height/length thresholds for pilots or police). Confirm escort requirements with the FDOT permit office / Rule 14-26.

Superload thresholds below are approximated from the fee table's top brackets (over 14' wide / over 18' high / over 120' long overdimension; over 199,000 lbs overweight); FDOT's formal superload/blanket-review definition is not in this fee excerpt.
Legal dimension limits (8'6" wide, 13'6" high, 53' semitrailer, 80,000 lbs) are statutory defaults not stated in the fee schedule; movement/curfew rules are not in this excerpt.

superload_thresholds.note: Approximated from FDOT fee Table 1A/1B: overdimension over 14' wide OR over 18' high OR over 120' long is not issued as an annual multi-trip permit (route-specific only, $125); overweight over 199,000 lbs is route-specific ($0.003 per 1,000 lbs per mile). Treat as manual-review triggers pending the formal FDOT superload definition.

single_trip.fee_formula: Overdimension 10-day trip permit: $5 (up to 12' wide / 13'6" high / 85' long), $15 (up to 14' wide / 14'6" high / 95' long), $25 (up to 14' wide / 18' high / 120' long, or over). Overweight 10-day trip: $0.27/mile up to 95,000 lbs, $0.32/mile up to 112,000, scaling to $0.47/mile up to 162,000, and $0.003 per 1,000 lbs per mile above 199,000 lbs. Add $3.33 admin over 80,000 lbs and $5 transmission fee; fees computed in 25-mile increments.
single_trip.note: Trip permits valid 10 days. Overweight dimension combos over 12' wide / 13'6" high / 85' long add a dimension fee, combined not to exceed $500. Governmental entities, special taxing districts, and certain agricultural/emergency moves are fee-exempt.

annual.note: 12-month multi-trip permits: overdimension $20-$500 by class; overweight $240-$500 by weight bracket; route-specific 3-month multi-trip $5-$250. Implements of husbandry/farm/forestry $17/yr.

notes: Only FDOT's Rule 14-26.008 fee schedule was available as source text; escort tiers, superload definition, legal limits, and curfew rules are flagged for verification.
